nodes.title:
Actually logical, but extra for Ziggy: 

You have to choose a sampler
and if you want to use img2img,
make sure that your sampler choice
matches the img2img settings,
otherwise the workflow might run into an error.

If you want to use Flux or Kolors Models,
always turn on Custom Advanced Sampler!

You can also use the Advanced Sampler
with SDXL models. (select only Advanced Sampler)

Flux CFG always 1.0.

For Pony Models set  Clipset to -2! and enable
PerturbedAttentionGuidance (Model Patch Group)

Always press buttons slowly and
most of the time the buttons you need
will switch on or off automatically.

Another tip:
Always switch off and on again,
not the other way around.
